lines.en: Mia, did you see the flags on the beach? The lifeguard warned us not to go in the water.
lines.pt: Mia, você viu as bandeiras na praia? O salva-vidas nos avisou para não entrar na água.

lines.en: I did. He also reminded everyone to keep their children close to the shore.
lines.pt: Vi. Ele também lembrou a todos de manter as crianças perto da margem.

lines.en: A man next to me ignored him, so the lifeguard told him to come out immediately.
lines.pt: Um homem ao meu lado o ignorou, então o salva-vidas mandou que ele saísse imediatamente.

lines.en: Typical. My aunt warned me not to swim here in autumn, because the currents are strong.
lines.pt: Típico. Minha tia me avisou para não nadar aqui no outono, porque as correntes são fortes.

lines.en: She was right. The forecast advised people to stay away from the water until Monday.
lines.pt: Ela tinha razão. A previsão aconselhou as pessoas a ficarem longe da água até segunda.

lines.en: And the hotel manager reminded us to return the beach chairs before six.
lines.pt: E o gerente do hotel nos lembrou de devolver as cadeiras de praia antes das seis.

lines.en: He also asked us not to leave any rubbish on the sand, and he warned us to watch out for jellyfish.
lines.pt: Ele também nos pediu para não deixar lixo na areia e nos avisou para ter cuidado com as águas-vivas.

lines.en: Jellyfish? Nobody warned me about that! The guide should have reminded us to wear sandals.
lines.pt: Águas-vivas? Ninguém me avisou disso! O guia deveria ter nos lembrado de usar sandálias.

lines.en: The police advised drivers not to park near the pier, since the road might flood this evening.
lines.pt: A polícia aconselhou os motoristas a não estacionar perto do píer, já que a rua pode alagar esta noite.

lines.en: Then let us follow the advice. I will remind you to move the car before the storm arrives.
lines.pt: Então vamos seguir o conselho. Vou lembrar você de tirar o carro antes da tempestade chegar.

lines.en: Good. Whoever warns people early saves a lot of trouble, so let us thank the lifeguard.
lines.pt: Boa. Quem avisa cedo evita muito problema, então vamos agradecer ao salva-vidas.

facts.big: He warned us not to go
facts.label: Avisos reportados
facts.sub: Use warned, advised ou reminded + pessoa + to + verbo: He warned us not to go. She reminded me to call.

facts.label: avisou para não
facts.sub: Use warned + pessoa + not to + verbo: He warned us not to go. Também pode usar warned + about: He warned us about the jellyfish. Warned nunca leva that + do.

facts.label: aconselhou a
facts.sub: Use advised + pessoa + to + verbo: The police advised drivers not to park there. É um conselho formal ou oficial, mais suave que told.

compare.ask: He warned us not to go.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ele nos avisou para não ir” e “ele me lembrou de ligar”.
compare.tip: Diga: “He warned us not to go.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use warned / advised / reminded + pessoa + to + verbo: He warned us not to go. She reminded me to call. Para negar, coloque not antes de to. Não use that nem do.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: He warned us not to go is correct.
We say “He warned us do not go”.
Reminded us to is used for things we must not forget.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: He warned us not to go is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “He warned us do not go”. → Falso (We say not to go.)
Reminded us to is used for things we must not forget. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A beach street in Miami · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a windy Friday afternoon in Miami. Dark clouds are coming from the sea. Hal and Nina walk along the street near the beach. Red flags move quickly in the wind. Everybody seems to have a warning to share. Today they practise warned, advised and reminded.

“Nina, did you see the flags on the beach? The lifeguard warned us not to go in the water.” says Hal. “I did. He also reminded everyone to keep their children close to the shore.” says Nina. “A man next to me ignored him, so the lifeguard told him to come out immediately.” says Hal.
